'''Hestun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Hestun enlisted the help of an Imperial hero to target the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] anti-air defenses so that his fleet could bombard the emplacements in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Governmental Sector|Government District]]. The Admiral was not permitted to bomb the entire sector—the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] himself wanted the Legislature intact. The hero was successful and Hestun's men accurately targeted the emplacements, but the Republic retained a foothold in the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] Library despite their loss.<ref name="TOR" />
